daily_thesis: The 2026-08-31 batch pushes robot and vision systems from plausible outputs toward action-release contracts. Geometry papers ask whether scale, coordinate frame, correspondence, sonar/LiDAR ambiguity, and onboard memory survive the path from reconstruction to action. VLA and manipulation papers make future dynamics, deictic reference, partial observability, contact, and bin-picking deadlock explicit execution variables. World-model and video papers convert memory from a generic cache into executable code, layer-routed retrieval, object-centric particles, and physics-aware dynamics. VLM and safety papers ask which cue, alarm, formal rule, ASR error, or QoS state should change the system decision before an answer or robot command is allowed.

clusters.cluster: Robot policies move from current-frame action decoding to horizon-conditioned repair decisions
clusters.why: 기존 VLA 평가는 현재 관측과 명령에서 바로 action을 내는 능력에 초점을 맞췄다. VLAct는 고정된 robot-data 예산에서 representation quality를 묻고, PHR-VLA는 future dynamics를 training signal로 넣으며, DeicticVLA와 ROBUST TAMP는 사용자 pointing과 새로 발견한 물체가 plan을 바꿔야 하는 순간을 다룬다. 따라서 APRL은 final success가 아니라 동일한 현재 프레임에서 미래 contact, deictic mask, hidden object, deadlock state가 action과 recovery timing을 어떻게 바꾸는지 비교해야 한다.
clusters.confidence_note: Six robot papers independently expose data budget, future horizon, instruction mode, partial observation, contact, and grasp deadlock as execution variables.
clusters.lab_action: LIBERO/RoboTwin과 bin-picking scenes에서 future contact label, deictic target mask, hidden object discovery, non-prehensile contact reward, occluded grasp deadlock을 독립 stress condition으로 두고 action delta, recovery trigger timing, contact error, terminal success를 비교한다.

frontier_memory.label: Strengthening
frontier_memory.history: August 24-28 repeatedly emphasized evidence-before-action, robot-usable geometry, VLA recovery, and world-model memory.
frontier_memory.body: August 31 strengthens that line with metric-aware geometry, planning-horizon VLAs, event-triggered TAMP, layer-routed video memory, and external safety alarms.

frontier_memory.label: New signal
frontier_memory.history: Recent daily editions discussed geometry validity but less often linked metric units and feed-forward reconstruction to field-scale mapping.
frontier_memory.body: MAGP and GeoFF3D make scale, coordinate anchoring, and large-scale aggregation explicit action-facing constraints.

frontier_memory.label: Commoditizing
frontier_memory.history: Token compression, video memory, VLM attention, and diffusion variants keep appearing across the last four weeks.
frontier_memory.body: The useful differentiation is not another compression ratio; it is whether compressed tokens, KV entries, events, or 3DGS parameters preserve decision-changing evidence.

frontier_memory.label: Missing axis
frontier_memory.history: The repo still has separate notes for VLA, mapping, VLM evidence, and runtime safety.
frontier_memory.body: APRL can combine them into one permission protocol where metric geometry, future evidence, and external alarms jointly decide action release.

strategy_board.title: Metric-geometry action contract
strategy_board.thesis: Make reconstruction methods report whether scale, pose, correspondence, and sensor ambiguity preserve the robot action they are supposed to support.
strategy_board.one_week: Build a small manipulation and UAV-mapping probe with metric objects, repeated viewpoints, sparse sonar/LiDAR cases, and known extrinsic perturbations.
strategy_board.one_week_probe: Build a small manipulation and UAV-mapping probe with metric objects, repeated viewpoints, sparse sonar/LiDAR cases, and known extrinsic perturbations.
strategy_board.four_week: Compare MAGP-style metric geometry, feed-forward reconstruction, MVS compression, I2P pruning, and multimodal UAV alignment on downstream route and grasp decisions.
strategy_board.four_week_build: Compare MAGP-style metric geometry, feed-forward reconstruction, MVS compression, I2P pruning, and multimodal UAV alignment on downstream route and grasp decisions.
strategy_board.success: At least one downstream action ranking changes relative to clean reconstruction or alignment metrics.
strategy_board.success_metric: At least one downstream action ranking changes relative to clean reconstruction or alignment metrics.
strategy_board.stop: If route and grasp decisions track ordinary reconstruction scores under every perturbation, narrow the protocol to metric-scale calibration only.
strategy_board.stop_condition: If route and grasp decisions track ordinary reconstruction scores under every perturbation, narrow the protocol to metric-scale calibration only.
strategy_board.paper_path: A robot-usable geometry release-gate paper connecting metric reconstruction to action-level error.

strategy_board.asset: Metric objects, coordinate-anchored maps, sensor ambiguity cases, extrinsic drift scripts, and route/grasp outcome labels.

strategy_board.thesis: Measure when future dynamics, deictic user intent, hidden object discovery, and contact evidence should revise a VLA or TAMP plan before failure.
strategy_board.one_week: Create paired episodes with identical current frames but different future contact outcomes, pointing targets, hidden objects, and deadlock states.
strategy_board.one_week_probe: Create paired episodes with identical current frames but different future contact outcomes, pointing targets, hidden objects, and deadlock states.
strategy_board.four_week: Evaluate VLAct-style pretraining, PHR-VLA future heads, DeicticVLA instruction modes, ROBUST TAMP triggers, and contact-guided exploration in one stress grid.
strategy_board.four_week_build: Evaluate VLAct-style pretraining, PHR-VLA future heads, DeicticVLA instruction modes, ROBUST TAMP triggers, and contact-guided exploration in one stress grid.
strategy_board.success: The benchmark separates policies that recover before contact failure from policies that only improve final success rate.
strategy_board.success_metric: The benchmark separates policies that recover before contact failure from policies that only improve final success rate.
strategy_board.stop: If all methods fail for the same obvious visibility reasons, split the suite into perception disambiguation and horizon reasoning tracks.
strategy_board.stop_condition: If all methods fail for the same obvious visibility reasons, split the suite into perception disambiguation and horizon reasoning tracks.
strategy_board.paper_path: A VLA execution-evidence paper centered on planning-horizon and repair-trigger diagnostics.

strategy_board.opportunity: Runtime evidence alarm and repair gate

strategy_board.one_week_probe: Instrument one computer-use or robot-control task with external telemetry alarms, manual-derived action constraints, ASR perturbations, and QoS state changes.
